gaps.detail: This purposive nine-case sample covers India, the US, the UK, Germany, Hong Kong and Australia. Africa, Latin America, the Middle East and most Asian and European publishers remain unsampled. No global concentration denominator or ranking is computed.

This packet concerns news publishers and their corporate parents. X/Twitter and other social platforms belong in a separate platform layer; shared owners do not erase operational or legal distinctions.

This ownership packet establishes no election-service, campaign-contract, political-donation or manipulation relationship. Advertising inventory, a campaign contract, private giving and corporate expenditure require separate evidence and relationship types.

The research cutoff is October 15, 2026. Each edge retains its own event or observation date; historical transactions do not automatically establish current holdings. The NDTV ownership snapshot is March 31, 2026. The News Corp proxy combines a September 2025 share count with an August 2026 denominator.

The FY 2026 annual report was found, but official NW18 and BSE PDF requests returned HTTP 403. No 2026 percentage was imported from aggregators. The opened Reliance-hosted FY 2025 note confirms the trust relationship, but the current aggregate promoter stake is not reconciled.

These sources establish transactions, positions and rights. Testing editorial intervention requires dated instructions, contractual rights, documented newsroom decisions and alternative explanations; a graph path alone is insufficient.

Funding ceilings, announced prices, statutory consideration, prior debt, per-share prices, rights-issue proceeds and net cash inflow must not be summed. The dataset supplies no currency conversion or cross-case monetary total.

Primary sources were checked by the researcher and programmatic validation is recorded separately. Independent review covers selected high-risk claims and does not establish exhaustive or continuously current global ownership.
No exhaustive latest Form 4/13D roll-forward; all ownership figures carry their actual snapshot date. No complete private cap tables for Neuralink or The Boring Company.

No primary contract establishing Tesla, SpaceX, xAI or Palantir as a vote-tabulation/election-administration vendor is acquired here. A PAC payment service, political contribution, social-media reach or government AI contract cannot fill that bridge.

2024 Musk processed query is complete for its exact 26-row response, but latest-report amendment chains for America and RBG were not fully reconciled after OpenFEC returned HTTP 429. Selected original electronic/PDF filings corroborate important rows. Never relabel committee-wide receipts as Musk money or add memo attributions to underlying partner contributions.

Space Force and CDAO original releases returned HTTP 403; CRS and issuer sources retained with lower access claims. Neuralink body empty; old Boring Series C page redirected to a September 2026 Series D page.

The X licensing, IMGE texting, Push Digital consulting/media and Western Creative media payments have filing evidence. No signed contract or particular targeting data is in this packet; no electoral outcome or manipulation claim follows.
Palantir snapshot is April 6, 2026; Meta snapshot March 31, 2022; Rumble investment May 19, 2021. No exhaustive current beneficial-ownership roll-forward for all businesses.
Need specific fund vehicles, capitalization tables and partner economic interests to determine personal stakes. Portfolio listings do not provide these.

No primary buyer–vendor contract showing a Thiel-owned company administering ballots, tabulation or voter registration was obtained. A bounded company/election search is not a national procurement census. Required next records: named jurisdiction and election, executed contract and amendments, statement of work, invoices, access logs, and certified system components.
No design estimates the causal effect of the verified contributions on election results, policy or public contracts; no bribery or quid-pro-quo inference is made.

Processed receipt responses and report-version chains were completely retrieved for two named committees and the 2022 cycle. Several direct FEC PDF/index opens failed; API references provide exact file/image/transaction locators. Independent-expenditure queries are samples, not exhaustive totals.
No inferred geographic coordinates or personal addresses are included. Country is null where the opened source set does not resolve the relevant legal entity or jurisdiction.
